messages:
Ava Nguyen: Hey team — I started today (Ava, AE). Quick access question: I don’t have Gong or HubSpot seats yet and I can’t open the sales playbook in the repo. Who should I ping for the seats and where’s the canonical playbook?

Ops IT: Welcome Ava! Please file a quick IT request so we can provision seats. Use this form and paste the output here: 
```
product: Sales tools
requester: Ava Nguyen
tools: Gong, HubSpot (full seat)
ssogroup: sales-engineering
access-needed-by: 2024-07-02
notes: new AE - onboarding
```
I’ll triage once you post the request ID. Also send us the email you signed up with (SSO).

Ava Nguyen: Thanks — request filed (REQ-5128). Email is ava@redwood.example. Can someone point me to the playbook link and the one-pagers for discovery?

Matt (sales): Hey Ava — welcome! Playbook lives in the Sales drive: https://drive.redwood.company/sales/playbooks -> folder "AE Onboarding 2024". Short path: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Onboarding. Start with the "Discovery Cheat Sheet" and our call calibration recordings. I’ll DM you schedule for shadowing Friday 10:30-12 (calls + debrief).

Lina (CS): FYI a few CS-specific items you might want: 
- Objection handling one-pager is under Playbooks -> Objections (filename: objections_v2.pdf)
- Pre-built sequences for HubSpot lives in sequences/shared-AE (ask @Matt to clone the right one)
- If you want a test CRM account, ping me and I’ll create a sandbox lead for you to practice logging activity.

Matt (sales): @Ava, once Gong is up, we use the Gong team folder for pitch cadences and call tags. Quick tip: enable auto-tagging rules under Settings -> Call Tags so QA can find your calls.

Ava Nguyen: Great — REQ-5128 says "Provisioning in progress". @Ops IT any idea ETA?

Ops IT: Should be done today (within 4 hours). If SSO mapping fails we’ll fallback to manual seat invite. I’ll post a comment in the ticket with the invite link.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Ava Nguyen! Your onboarding checklist was created: /onboarding/checklists/ava_nguyen_1742543210. Tasks added: Account setup, CRM walkthrough, Shadow session with Matt, First 10 calls review.

Lina (CS): Also — if you need slide decks for vertical-specific collateral (SaaS / FinServ), check the Collateral repo: /Sales/Collateral/By-Vertical. If you want, I can share a 20-min rundown after your first shadow.

Matt (sales): Putting a quick plan here: 
- Today: seats + playbook + intro to Gong UI (if available)
- Fri 10:30-12: shadow 3 discovery calls + 15-min debriefs
- Next week: roleplay and first solo call with supervision

Ava Nguyen: Thanks all — I’ll wait for the ticket update and start reading the playbook. Appreciate the quick responses :rocket:

Ops IT: Ticket updated: REQ-5128 -> invited via SSO; HubSpot seat granted; Gong invite sent. Check your inbox, accept the invite and log in with SSO. If you get a 403, reply here and we’ll force re-map.

Ava Nguyen: Got both invites and playbook link. Logged in to Gong fine. See you Friday Matt.

Matt (sales): Awesome. Ping here if anything breaks. Welcome aboard! :tada:
